description: Keeps every repo on the newest Node.js LTS line, moving all of a repo's Node pins together.

customManagers.description: Read a `>=N` Node floor in package.json engines as a Node pin, so it moves with CI, .nvmrc and the Docker base. Renovate's own engines handling never raises a `>=` floor.

packageRules.description: Move every Node pin in a repo to a new LTS major in one PR. There is no ceiling: a new LTS line is proposed as soon as Renovate sees it.
Node's odd-numbered lines never become LTS, so the types skip them too.
The floor names a line, not a release: only a new LTS major moves it, never a minor or patch.
